steps.title: Original GLQuake server to MiniQuake client
MiniQuake server to original GLQuake client

hotfixes.fix: brace Scenario interpolation before a literal colon and add package-wide verifier protection
use canonical --root invocation and retain the historical positional root as a compatibility alias

hotfixes.classification: External original-binary harness / GL-capable server launch mode
hotfixes.fix: run verified GLQUAKE.EXE as a windowed listen server because GL map loading requires a WGL context; add remote-client and early-exit diagnostics

hotfixes.classification: External original-binary harness / legacy debug-log overflow
hotfixes.fix: omit -condebug for all original GLQuake GUI runs and replace qconsole evidence with Protocol summaries, process liveness and screenshot files

hotfixes.classification: External original-binary harness / unattended firewall isolation
hotfixes.fix: bind original and MiniQuake interop endpoints exclusively to 127.0.0.1; disable UDP for original visual runs so Windows Firewall does not require an interactive approval prompt

hotfixes.classification: external original-binary harness / temporary Windows Defender Firewall authorization
hotfixes.fix: request elevation before build, install four exact-program UDP loopback-only rules, remove them in finally, and preserve timeout logs

hotfixes.classification: external original-binary harness / original console port tokenization
hotfixes.fix: pass the original client target port through -port/net_hostport and execute connect 127.0.0.1 without a colon; add parallel process diagnostics

hotfixes.engine_change_scope: startup evidence gamma, GL clear colour and brush-model render handoff
hotfixes.fix: match original -gamma 1 startup palette, preserve red GL clear colour, and route brush entities through canonical animated GL_LUMINANCE lightmap rendering

hotfixes.classification: external original-server interop / false-positive local fallback
hotfixes.fix: require the accepted signon-4 client to use UDP to the requested peer and reject local-server, local-authoritative and demo fallbacks; independently enforce the same markers in PowerShell

hotfixes.classification: external original-server interop / cold-start readiness race
hotfixes.fix: wait for a real CCREP_SERVER_INFO response from the exact original-server UDP endpoint before launching the full MiniQuake client; bind-test random loopback ports and emit readiness diagnostics
resolve and validate the external reference before elevation/build, forward it explicitly and via environment fallback, require exactly one selector, and record the effective argument contract

hotfixes.engine_change_scope: interop-only persistent control socket and strict connection path
hotfixes.fix: reuse one UDP source endpoint, resend CCREQ_CONNECT every 500 ms, bypass startup +connect fallback, and emit raw packet diagnostics

hotfixes.classification: external original-server startup sequencing and readiness guard lifetime
hotfixes.fix: consume the private original target during Host_Init before standalone fallback, reuse the same persistent handshake, and keep the readiness UDP guard open until after the original process stops

hotfixes.classification: external original-TGA completion race and bounded reference-run variance
hotfixes.fix: wait for complete byte-stable TGAs and use a dual-reference minimum-SSIM gate

hotfixes.classification: external original/MiniQuake visual simulation timestep parity
hotfixes.fix: set original host_framerate to 0.02 before timedemo so time-dependent damage kick and cshift decay match MiniQuake evidence

optimization.scope: CR3 inline/array hotpaths plus binary live output and exact named build parameter binding
